_about: Lycantrope idea tracker state. Source of truth for idea decisions. IDs come from IDEAS.md and OBJECTS.md ('file' says which; 'in_ideas_md' means the ID still exists in its source file). status is one of: awaiting, approved, denied. 'ui' records what the user had selected/filtered in the tracker window. Edit via tools/idea_tracker.py (GUI or CLI); the GUI hot-reloads this file.
